text: can you make the vertex and edges more pronounced. the vertex are small and edges are white on a white model that loads in so its like a pain in my fkn ass to see anything
resolution: Made the edit-mode markers pronounced and fixed white-on-white. Two changes: (1) the scene3d wireframe was a fixed light-blue line that vanished on the light-grey default model; it's now ADAPTIVE per-fragment — a dark line over light surfaces, a light line over dark ones (luminance threshold biased low at 0.32 so the default model gets crisp dark edges). This is a strict improvement for every <Scene3D wireframe> user; the wire can no longer disappear into the surface. (2) Vertex dots are bigger and HALOED — every dot, edge highlight, and marquee line now draws twice (a dark disc/stroke under a bright fill) so it reads on a white model AND the dark void, which a single colour can't do. Unselected verts 8px white, selected 13px orange; selected edges 4px orange; marquee 2px; all with the dark halo (overlayDot/overlayLine helpers in 3d.zig). Built clean; headless RJIT_MESHMODE=1 shows bold dots over a clearly-dark wireframe. Live verifies in rjit dev.
